title: Ranking + anti-gaming: balanced blend, Top-this-week decay, rate-spam resistance (AUTH #026)
summary: The ranking pipeline (SPEC §3.7): a balanced blend of the four-axis community ratings (fun/interesting/interactive/exciting) and derived objective signals (verticality, move variety, reachable volume, completion rate, replay rate), with a time-decay for 'Top this week', recency for 'New', and a Room/Tabletop filter for 'Near your scale'. Weights are telemetry-tunable (config-driven, not hardcoded). Anti-gaming (rate-limits, one-rating-per-account-per-environment, self-rating and brigade detection) must survive a deliberate rate-spam test (M4 exit).

acceptance_tests.test: The ranking blends the four-axis ratings and the five derived signals into a score with config-driven (tunable) weights; derived signals are computed from the environment_spec / telemetry, never creator-supplied.
'Top this week' applies a time-decay, 'New' is recency, and 'Near your scale' filters Room vs Tabletop.
Anti-gaming survives a deliberate rate-spam test (M4 exit): a scripted spam attack does not materially move an environment's rank (SECURITY_CHECKLIST §10.2).

history.event: created by the Coordinator (M4 decomposition, AUTH #026): Owner chose the balanced-blend ranking.
